title: Protect the edge of the box
titleKid: Guard the front of our box
brief: Their #8 is about to play the ball out to their winger, deep in your half.
briefKid: Their midfielder is about to pass to their winger, near our goal.
question: Their winger is running at your box from the wing. Where do you go?
questionKid: Their winger is running at our box. Where do you go?

takeaway.standard: When the ball is wide in your own third, the #6 drops to the edge of the box on the ball side, blocking the pass inside and the cut-back, while the defenders guard the goal.
takeaway.kid: When they attack near our goal, run back to the front of our box.

misconceptions.text: You stayed in midfield, so the edge of your box is empty for a cut-back or a pass inside.
misconceptions.textKid: Run back! Guard the front of our box.

misconceptions.text: You dropped into the back line; they already have the box covered, so stay just in front of them to block the pass inside.
misconceptions.textKid: Too far back! Stay just in front of your defenders.
